To ensure fairness and equality for both parents when deciding to have a baby or not there would need to be 4 options:
1. Both parents decided to keep the baby.
2. Mom wants the baby but dad doesn’t. Then dad will sign off on all parental rights/decision for baby; and all financial obligations and upbringing requirements will be the sole responsibility of the mother.
3. Dad wants the baby but mom doesn’t. Then mom will sign off on all parental rights/decisions for baby; and all financial obligations and upbringing requirements will be the sole responsibility of the father.
4. Both parents decided to have an abortion.

If these were the legal options available today, I believe you would see people acting more responsibly.
